answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a bond before bidding, with reserves held in a basalt account and a forge issuing auditable stake receipts. Random audits compare task behavior and funding links; proven duplicate control burns the bond. The attacker must immobilize one full stake per Sybil and risks losing each one, so influence grows in linear cost. A karst funding graph helps auditors trace wallets that split and rejoin.
